name: Fundamentals of GoF Design Patterns
description: Test your understanding of the pillars and goals of the main GoF design patterns.

questions.question: What is the main goal of behavioral design patterns?
questions.explain: Behavioral patterns focus on how objects interact and distribute responsibilities.

questions.question: What characterizes a structural design pattern?
options: They solve problems related to the organization of classes and objects
They manage data flow between components
They manage the lifetime of objects
They define interactions between distributed systems
questions.explain: Structural patterns deal with the composition of classes and objects to form larger structures.

questions.question: What is the overall goal of the Singleton pattern?
options: Allow multiple instances of a class
questions.explain: Singleton restricts the instantiation of a class to a single global instance.

questions.question: The Factory Method pattern belongs to which category?
questions.explain: Factory Method is a creational pattern focused on flexible object creation.

questions.question: Which pattern is used to convert incompatible interfaces?
questions.explain: Adapter converts one interface into another so classes can work together despite incompatible interfaces.

questions.question: The Observer pattern is classified as _______.
questions.explain: Observer is a behavioral pattern that defines a dependency relationship between objects.

questions.question: What does the Strategy pattern aim to solve?
questions.explain: Strategy allows defining a family of algorithms and making them interchangeable.

questions.question: Which pattern is used to avoid multiple base classes?
questions.explain: Bridge separates an interface from its implementation to avoid direct coupling.

questions.question: What does the Command pattern implement?
options: An interface for managing single instances
questions.explain: Command encapsulates a request as an object, allowing parameterization of requests.

questions.question: Which pattern is used to control access to objects?
questions.explain: Proxy controls access to an object and can add extra logic such as lazy loading.
